Warranty terms

Standard warranty

Every product carries a 2-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects, starting on the delivery date.

What is not covered

  • Accidental damage such as drops, spills or cracked screens.
  • Normal wear, including worn keycaps and faded coatings.
  • Repairs attempted by anyone other than an authorised service centre.

Accidental damage protection

Accidental damage protection can be added within 30 days of purchase for 15 percent of the product price. It covers one accidental-damage claim per year.

How to claim

Open a support ticket with your order number and a short description. Warranty repairs usually take 10 business days.
